info.title: fernbank ledger API
info.description: Portfolio-quality banking/ledger API. Educational project - play money only, not a real financial service.

post.description: Destination is either destinationAccountId or destinationAccountNumber, never both. Transfers above the step-up threshold require a recent MFA elevation (POST /api/v1/auth/step-up) or fail with 403 step-up-required.

post.description: Reusing an already-rotated refresh token is treated as theft: it revokes the entire token family, including the legitimately-rotated successor.

post.summary: Complete login for an MFA-enrolled user
post.description: Exchanges the mfaToken challenge from POST /api/v1/auth/login plus a TOTP or single-use recovery code for real access/refresh tokens.
Returns a new secret and otpauth:// URI (render as a QR code); not yet active until confirmed via POST .../enroll/confirm.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrollment with a code from the authenticator app
post.description: Activates MFA and returns one-time recovery codes - shown to the user exactly once.
Idempotent - an unknown or already-revoked token still returns 204.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Repeated failures trip a rate limit and lock the account (429/423-style lockout surfaced as 401 on subsequent attempts). If MFA is enabled, returns a challenge status instead of tokens - see LoginResponse.status.

200.description: Authenticated, or an MFA challenge issued

get.description: Public key material only - safe to expose without authentication, used by resource servers/clients to verify access-token signatures.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's own identity
get.description: Resolved entirely from the JWT subject - never from a client-supplied id.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's own active sessions (refresh tokens)
get.description: No device/IP metadata is stored, so a 'this device' flag can't be shown - only issued/expiry times.

get.summary: Cursor-paginated login history for the authenticated user
get.description: Keyset pagination: pass the previous page's nextCursor to fetch the next page. Scoped to the caller's own auth-relevant events only.

get.summary: Run a full ledger reconciliation check
get.description: Verifies every currency's ledger entries sum to zero and every account balance matches its ledger entries. Also runs hourly on a schedule.

200.description: Reconciliation report, healthy or listing discrepancies

get.description: Keyset pagination: pass the previous page's nextCursor to fetch the next page.

get.summary: Get one account owned by the authenticated customer
get.description: Returns 404 (not 403) for a cross-customer accountId - existence is never leaked. Supports conditional GETs via ETag/If-None-Match.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag from a previous response; a match returns 304 with no body

200.description: The account, with an ETag header

304.description: Not Modified - the supplied If-None-Match matches the current ETag

get.summary: Get a cursor-paginated statement of ledger entries for one account
get.description: Keyset pagination: pass the previous page's nextCursor to fetch the next page.

get.summary: Export a full-range statement as CSV or PDF
get.description: Unpaginated - returns every entry in [from,to], capped at 10,000 rows; narrow the range if the cap is exceeded.

delete.summary: Delete a payee owned by the authenticated customer
delete.description: Returns 404 (not 403) for a cross-customer payeeId - existence is never leaked.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the authenticated user's own sessions
delete.description: Idempotent - an unknown or already-revoked session id still returns 204, same as logout. A session id belonging to another user returns 404, not 403 - existence is never leaked.

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details, as produced by every error response in this API.

correlationId.description: Echoes the X-Correlation-Id request header; auto-assigned if absent.

amount.description: Decimal string, using the currency's own minor-unit precision (e.g. 2 places for USD) - must be strictly positive.

TransferRequest.description: Exactly one of destinationAccountId or destinationAccountNumber must be provided, never both or neither - enforced at request-handling time, not by field validation, and rejected with a 400 bad-request if violated.

destinationAccountId.description: Destination by account id - mutually exclusive with destinationAccountNumber.

destinationAccountNumber.description: Destination by account number - mutually exclusive with destinationAccountId.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request - bad input shape, missing header, or a business rule that isn't a field-level validation failure.

ValidationFailed.description: Request failed Bean Validation; the response's `errors` extension lists each field error.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired, tampered, or otherwise invalid credentials.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but not permitted to perform this action (wrong role, or step-up elevation required).

NotFound.description: The resource doesn't exist, or exists but isn't owned by the authenticated customer - identical response either way, so existence is never leaked.

Conflict.description: The resource is not in a state that allows this operation, or the same Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body.

UnprocessableContent.description: The request is well-formed but violates a domain rule (e.g. insufficient funds, currency mismatch).

InternalError.description: An unexpected server error. Never includes a stack trace or SQL - correlate via `correlationId`.
